༄༅/ /thams cad rig pa'i cho ga 'khor ba kun grol gyi zur 'debs bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor ba kun grol gyi

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thams cad rig pa'i cho ga 'khor ba kun grol

gyi zur 'debs bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor ba kun grol gyi zur 'debs cung zad brjod par bya'o/ /de la bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /gnyis las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nang khrus nas/ sdigs par mdzad pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar yongs rdzogs sam/ bsdu na lce lag byin gyis brlab pa med kyang chog pas/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las/ rang nyid rdo rje khro bo me ltar 'bar ba/ nas/ sdigs par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ badzra satwa kro dha nas hū ཾ phaṭa/ lan dgu oṃ badzra tsakra hū ཾ / nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ shu n+yā ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi stengadu/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ / 'di dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad kyi thun mong gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ kun rig kho na ltar na oṃ dang 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed pa nyid bzang bas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs dzaḥhū ཾ nas dri shya hoḥ.arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyi mchod/ oṃ badzra aṃ gu sha sogs kyis dgug gzhug bcings mnyes bya/ rdor sems sam rnam snang nyid kyis phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab bya/ de rjes oṃ bhri ta sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur ba rnams dang po sbyor ba bzhin du bya/

de rjes bzlas pa ci 'grub bya ste/ rnam snang du bsgom na/ oṃ sarba bid sogs gtso bo'i sngags 'bum phrag bzhi 'am/ bcu drug dang*/ rdor sems su bsgom na/ oṃ badzra sa twā hūṃ/ 'bum phra ga drug go /gnya ིsa ka'ang rtsa ba'i rig pa bzhi 'bum la sogs pa bzla ba yin zhing*/ thun 'jog khar arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mtshan brgya'am/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mas bstod/ thun mtshams kyi 'phral spyod ji ltar byed pa dang bstun te phyag rgya bgrol ba'am mi bgrol ba skabs su gang bab bya/ ma bkrol na thun snga ma rnams la thun 'jug tu bsnyen pa'i lha rang gnas su bzhugs/ thugs ka nas lha gnyis pa spros nas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba mdzad/ thun phyi ma rnams kyi mgo la de thugs kar bzhugs nas/ mchod bstod sngon du 'gro ba'i bzlas par bya/ gal te phyag rgya bkrol na/ thun re re bzhin mgo nas skyor/ thun tha ma la ni nges par phyag rgya bkrol te/ gshegs su gsol nas smon lam btab/ me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags lan dgus bsrung ba byas nas/ gnyid kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya zhing*/ gang ltar yang thun mtshams su gsung rab bklag pa dang*/ tshwa tshwa gdab pa dang*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /tshul des rtsa rig 'bum phrag bzhi 'am/ rdor sems sam rnam snang gi snying po kho na byed tshe 'bum phrag bcu drug bzla ba'ang yod do/ / snying po rkyang pas kyang go chod tsam yin mod kyi/ de dag kyang rtsa rig bzang la/ lag len la gnyis kar bzla ba'ang mdzad cing*/ nges par yang gal che'o/ /de tsam gyis dbang bskur ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi las byed pa la dbang bar 'gyur zhing*/ dngos grub kyi don du ni de tsam gyis mi chog ste mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'o/ /bsgom bya lha'i dbang du byas na/ rdor sems ni rgyud 'di las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad kyi spyi khyab yin zhing*/ rnam snang shāka thub sogs dkyil 'khor so so'i gtso bo ni/

dkyil 'khor gzhan tha dad la mi 'jug pas sgos kyi'ang yin la/ rang rangagi dkyil 'khor der gtogs pa'i lha thams cad 'jug pas spyi ru yang gtogs so/ /'khor gyi lha me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa ni sgos kyi bsnyen pa kho na yin par shes par bya'o/ /sngags kyang rtsa rig kun 'gro dang*/ gtso bo bcu gnyis dang*/ rdor sems ma gtogs me tog phog pa'i lha'i de sgos kyi dang*/ dkyil 'khor so so'i gtso bo ni gnyis ka'i cha la brten pa yin no/ /de'i phyir rab tu rdor sems kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song nas rtsa rig dang*/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po'i gtso bo mtha' dag gi bsnyen pa legs par byas nas/ de'i 'og tu rang 'dod pa'i lha de bzung bar bya'o/ /'bring du na/ rdor sems dang kun rig nyid do/ / gnyis ka ma grub na rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa la kun rig gi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su/ rdor sems dang rnam snang gang byas kyang 'dra mod kyi/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la 'jug che ba'i dbang du byas na/ lha rdor sems dang sngags rtsa rig kho na bsngags mod kyi/ rdor sems su bskyed phyin ni rdor sems nyid kyi sngags 'bum phrag drug tu bzla ba nges par dgos pas/ de yang rtsa rig gi thog mar bzlas na legs so/ /yang rnam snang du bskyed na/ rnam snang sgos kyi bstod pa re yang byas na legs te/ des gzhan la'ang mtshon no/ /rgyud sde 'di nyid la gtso bor byed na/ spyi bsnyen sgos bsnyen tshang ma bskyal na legs la/ 'di la gtso bor mi byed pa dag gis ni/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pas/ dkyil 'khor gzhan bcu gnyis kyi'ang dkyil 'khor kyi bya ba la 'jug tu rung bar shes par bya'o/ /ci ste bdag bskyed rgyas pa bsgoms te bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad skyel du mi rung ba zhig gam/ khyod bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i tha snyad mi 'dod pa ci zhe na/ spyir mi rung ba dang ta ma yin zhing*/

bsnyen pa'i dod thub pa'ang yin srid la/ der ma zad gang zag gi khyad par 'ga' zhig la/ bsnyen pa dngos lha rkyang re bsgoms pa las bzang bar 'gyur ba'ang srid mod kyi/ de 'dra de sgrub pa rje mthun pa tsam yin pas bsnyen pa gzhan sngon du ma song na sgrub pa'i 'dra lcog ces bya la/ bsnyen pa dang bsnyen pa rjes mthun pa gnyis kar ma yin pas/ lugs 'di la bsnyen par mi bsdu ste/ rgyud sde gong ma'i bsnyen pa la dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yod pa'i rigs 'grai 'dir mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum ste/ dang po la sa chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs su bshad pa ltar gtor ma btang*/ de nas khyad par bka' bsgo drag tu byas te bgegs rnams bskrad/ drag sngags brjod cing rol mo dang bcas sa gzhi la yungs kar gyis brabs/ sa gzhi lag pas mnan te/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ mang du bzlas/ sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ bhu khaṃ mang du brjod/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ laṃ hū ཾ / mang du bzlas/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ lce lag byin rlabs nas/ /mtshan brgya yan chad bzlas pa dngabacas pa'i bar bya/ hūṃ zhes sa gzhi g.yas bskor du lan gsum bcags/ oṃ badzra satwa kro dha 'i sngags lan gsum gyi bsrung ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon la/ sa'i lha mo'i sta gon spyi dang mthun/ oṃ tshur byon sogs bla med kyi khyad chos yin pas brjod mi dgos so/ / skyobs pa sangs rgyas sogs kyi gsol ba 'debs/ lha lhag gnas ni/ thig chen brgyad dang skya thig ji ltar 'os tsam btab nas/ lha gnas rnams su dri bzang thig le bya/ mchod pa bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ sa gzhi/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ zla ba'i gdan re re'o/ ma lus sems can kun gyi

nas/ ka ma la ye st+wa ཾ gyi bar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa nas/ 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir zhes pa nas/ thams cad skad cig gis grub par gyur/ gyi gzhan 'dra ba las sa bon rnams dor/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma dang/ bstod ring gis bstod/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sogs kyis snyan gsan phab/ oṃ khyod kyi sogs gshegs su gsol ba'am/ oṃ badzra udhi ṣṭha sa nam mkhar btegs pa gang rung bya/ gtor ma cha gsum gtong*/ bum pa sta gon ni/ dkyil chog las bshad pa'i bum sgrub byed pa ste/ 'dir byas zin pas dngos gzhi nyi ma dang po la bum sgrub mi dgos so/ /slob ma sta gon ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang sogs kyis bsam pa brtan po bskyed/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi sogs sngags kyis che ba brjod/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdud nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pa'i nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ ces nyan par gdams/ dbangamed bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*/ zhes sogs rgyun bshags bya/ oṃ bhri ta bhri ta sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/ badzra satwa/ badzra ratna/ badzra dharma/ badzra karma/ zhes gnas bzhir dri bzang gi thig le bya/ spro na gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis byin rlabs kyang bya/ dri chab la sogs pa mchod pa bzhis mchod kyang legs/ rdo rje bzhad pa'i sngags kyis so shing dang*/ rnon pos ku sha dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa hū ཾ ngam/ spyi mthun gyis khyor chu dang*/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag sogs kyis zab mo'i chos bshad dang*/ oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ/ zhes pas dpung skud byin/ oṃ badzra satwa uṣṇi ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/

ces pas rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste bsrung ba byas la/ kye bzhin bzang rnams longs la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag byos shig /nang par dkyil 'khor chen po mthor bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes brjod do/ kha cig dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro la slob ma sta gon du 'dod pa ni/ blun pa las kyang ches blun pa'i rtags bstan pa yin la/ gal te de de 'dra yin na/ bdag 'jug la slob ma sta gon nges par byed dgos par thal ba dang*/ cho ga nyin gcig ma la sa chog dang sta gon gyi rim pa gzhan gang yang mi dgos shing*/ slob ma sta gon kho na dgos pa'i khyad par yod par thal ba dang*/ tshad ldan nas bshad pa'i slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga gang yang de na med cing*/ de na yod pa rnams cig shos na med pas de 'dra slob ma sta gon min pa sogs skyon du ma 'jug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a las byung ba'i dam tshig gi thig tshon rnams sa bon lnga po de dag gis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis su ma dang ḍā las nyi zla hū ཾ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ dīpta dṛ ṣtaṃ aṃ gu sha dzaḥ'abar ba'i lta bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon bkug ste dam tshig pa la thim/ oṃ a no n+ya sogs bzla zhing thig skud bsgril/ oṃ badzra sa mā ya su draṃ mā ti kra ma hū ཾ / brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ puṣpe/ dhūpe/ gandhe/ gsum gyis mchod/ rdul tshon la/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ye hūṃ/ rdul tshon lnga'i khongs su brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ kha cig re re bzhin bdun bzla zer ba'ang yod/ hiḥ zhes lan mang du bzlas pas spar/ puṣpe sogs gsum gyis mchod/ de nas thig gdab cing rdul tshon gyis bri'o//thig rtsa dang tshon thob ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/

/gnyis pa sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ gsum pa gzhug cing dbang blang ba ni/ dkyil chog nyid na gsal bar yod pa de kho na'o/ /da ni phyag rgya rim pa nyer mkho rnams bshad par bya ste/ mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs kyi skabs/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi las rgya ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung cung zad gug pa mche ba ltar byas pa'o/ /rdo rje me'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje nang bsdams kha phye ba'i gung mo dang srin lag gi bar du/ mthe bong lto sbyar ba'o//rdo rje bsdams pa ni/ thal mo kha sbyar sor mo rnams rtsa ba nas bsnol/ lag mgo sor mo rnams kyi phan tshun du bsdams pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya ni/ 'ga' zhig sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyar 'dod mod/ 'dir lag pa g.yon steng g.yas 'og tu bsnol nas/ rgyab sbyar mthe bong dang mthe chung 'dud/ sor mo gzhan gsum mnyam par brkyang ba'o/ / badzra satwa kro dha'i skabs/ me ltar 'bar ba'i phyag ni/ khu tshur g.yas steng g.yon 'og tu byas te/ /thad kar rgyab sprad la/ mthe chung 'dud cing mdzub mo brkyang ba'o/ /rgyud 'di nyid kyi hūṃ mdzad dang me ltar 'bar ba gcig par bzhed kyang*/ spyir hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya hū ཾ bzhi pa'i sngags dang 'brel ba ni de dang 'dra ba las lag ngar g.yas 'og tu byas pa'o/ / ti rinti ra 'i phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje nang bsdams las steng nas mthe bong gnyis bkab pa'o// oṃ ṭu ཾ gi skabs dgos pa'i gnas dgu ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ bgegs la bsnun pa'i phyag rgya ni/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag /g.yas rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul du khu tshur bskyod pa'o/ /sreg pa ni me'i phyag rgya'o/ /bcing ba'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis gshibs te mnan pa'o/ /'og bcing ba ni/ rdor bsdams brkyang ba sa la 'jog tshul lo/ /steng bcing ba ni/ khur tshur gnyis las mdzub mo brkyang*/

/'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar bskor ba'i rjes su khu tshur kha sprad mdzub mo lcags kyu'i tshul du byas nas mgo steng du bzhag pa'o/ /'di la rdo rje 'jigs byed spyan gyi phyag rgya zer/ /steng du rdo rje bla bre 'god pa la rdo rje thal mo las mthe bong gnyis brkyang mdzub mo mche ba ltar byed pa/ gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /shar bcing ba la rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe chung sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad de mgo gzhug zlog nas spyi bor bkod pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /shar gyi nang bcing ba la lag pa bsnol/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad/ 'khrig ma gnyis bar stongs dang bcas pa zhags mig ltar byed pa ni zhags pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdor bsdams las mthe chung gnyis gshebs te brkyang*/ mdzub mo gnyis phral te brkyang ba ni nub bcing ba ste/ ba dan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /gong gi gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya de kha'i thad kar bzhag pa ni/ byang phyogs bcing ba ste rdo rje nag mo'i dus kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan te gshibs/ cung zad gyen du bskyod pa ni ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul te/ rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba lho bcing pa'o/ /

hū ཾ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las gung mo gnyis kyang bshibs te bsgreng ba ni rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya ste/ phyogs mtshams thams cad bcing ba'o/ / hūṃ brgyad kyi skabs hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bskor ba'o/ / badzra bandha 'i skabs rdo rje bsdams pa bskor ba'o/ /bsrung 'khor gyi gzhug tu byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi'i phyag rgya 'cha' ba ni/ rdor bsdams brkyangaba'i mthe bong dang mthe chung rtse sprad pa rdo rje las dang*/ de dang 'dra ba mdzub mo rtse sprad pa bsrung ba dang*/ /rdor bsdams las mdzum mo gnyis brkyang ba gnod sbyin dang*/ rdor bsdams mthe bong nang du chug pa khu tshur gyi'o/ /mnyam pa'i thal mo kha sbyor khong stong cung zad yod pa'o/ /rdo rje thal mo ni de dang 'dra ba las sor mo'i rtse mo rnams cung zad bsnol ba ste/ g.yon pa rnams 'og dang g.yas pa rnams steng du'o/ khu tshur gyi dam rgya ni gong du bshad ma thag pa nyid do/ / badzra satwa kro dha 'i phyag rgya ni rgyud 'di'i rang lugs yin la gzhan bsrung 'khor skabs kyi 'di rnams rdor dbyings kyi cho ga nas blangs pa sha stag go /dpral ba byin gyis rlobs pa ni mnyam pa'i thal mo'o/ /mgrin par byin gyis rlobs pa ni thal mo ka pu ta re/ /thal mo sbug sbug por sbyar ba las mdzub gung srin gsum cung zad kha phye ba'o/ /snying ga byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdor thal las gung mo gnyis dang sor mo tha ma bzhi sbyar te brkyang ba'am/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo mtha' bzhi brkyang ba gang rungaste phyi ma 'di legs pa 'dra'o/ /rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs pa la rdor bsdams las gung mo gshibs te brkyang*/ mtha' bzhi so sor bsgreng ba ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya ste mgo bo'i dbus su reg pa'o/ /de dang 'dra ba las mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis rtse sprad nas zlum por byas pa padma'i 'dab ma dang 'dra ba ni/ sbyong rgyal lam de bzhin gshegs pa'o/

/de dang 'dra ba las mdzub mo rin po che dang 'dra bar byas pa ni/ rna ltag g.yas su ste rin chen nam dbang bskur phyag rgya'o/ /mthe bong gnyis dang mthe chung gnyis so sor sbyar/ gzhan rnams phral te brkyang ba ni sdig pa sreg pa'am padma'i phyag rgya ste ltag par reg go /srin lag gnyis lto sbyar/ de'i rgyab tu gung mo dang*/ de'i yang rgyab tu mdzub mo sbyar/ mthe bong dang mthe chung so sor gshibs pa ni/ las kyi rigs kyi phyag rgya ste/ rna ltag g.yon tu bzhag par bya'o/ /phyag rgya bzh-i'i rgyas gdab kyi skabs su/ mchod yon 'bul ba'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'o/ /dam rgya la thog ma'i sa mā ya st+waṃ dang*/ su ra ta st+waṃ la thal mo mnyam par brdabs te thal mo'i tshul du bya/ de nas rdo rje bsdams pa bcings te/ sarba bid dri shya dza hū ཾ baṃ hoḥs mā ya st+waṃ man chad nas so so'i snying po dang rang sngags rdzogs kyi bar la/ so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'cha' ba yin te/ lag pa g.yon gan rkyal gyi steng du g.yas pa yang bzhag /mthe bong lto sprad pa ni/ gtso bo rnam snang gi dam rgya'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa 'i phyag rgya ni sbyong rgyal gyi'o/ /ratna'i phyag rgya ni rgyal mchog rin chen gyi'o/ /padma'i phyag rgya ni shākya thub pa'i 'o/ /karma'i phyag rgya ni/ rgyal mchog me tog gi'o/ /yang sangs rgyas bzhi po de la gtso bo dang 'dra bar byed pa'ang lugs gcig go /rdo rje nang bsdams las gung mo rtse sprad/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs dang po la btsugs/ mthe bong gnyis kyis sor mo lhag ma bzhi mnan pa ni/ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i 'o/ /thal sbyang las srin lag dang mthe chung nang du bcug mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje rwa cung zad gdengs pa ltar byed pa ni mā ma kī'o/ /thal sbyar las gung mo gnyis pad 'dab ltar byas/ mthe chung gnyis phral te brkyang ba ni gos dkar mo'i 'o/

/thal mo sbug por sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar/ /mthe bong gnyis kyang gung mo la sbyar zhing*/ lhag ma bsnol ba ni sgrol ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdor bsdams las mdzum mo gnyis gshibs te brkyang la rtse sbyar ba ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa lcags kyu ltar dgug pa ni rdo rje rgyal po'i'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje mda'i ltong ltar brkyang ba ni me tog dang 'dra ba zhes bya ste rdo rje chags pa'i'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste/ mthe bong gnyis dang rtse sprad la/ se gol gtogs tshul du byas pa ni rdo rje legs pa'i'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis tshigs bar ma bcag ste rin po che ltar byed pa ni rdo rje rin chen gyi'o/ /de dang 'dra ba las sor mo lhag ma rnams 'od zer 'bar ba ltar so sor phral te brkyang ba ni rdo rje gzi brjid kyi'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid spyi bor bzhag pa ni rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid g.yas su bskor te kha'i thad du bzhag pa ni rdo rje bzhad pa'o/ /rdor bsdams las mdzub mo gnyis padma 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje chos kyi'o/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mor sbyar nas ral gri ltar byas pa ni rdo rje rnon po'i'o/ /de nyid rtse mo sbyar te gdub bu ltar byas pa ni rdo rje rgyu'i 'o/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba las mdzub mo cung zad kha phye ba ni rdo rje smra ba'i 'o/ /de dang 'dra ba las rdo rje rtse mo cung zad phyir bskyed pa ni rdo rje las kyi'o/ /rtse mo shin tu bskyed pa ni rdo rje bsrung ba'i 'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo sgur bor byas pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o/ /de nyid la mdzub mo gnyis so sor mdun du bkug pa ni rdo rje khu tshur gyi'o/ /rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag pa ni sgeg mo'i 'o/ /dpral bar bzhag pa ni 'phreng ba ma'i 'o/

kha'i thad nas 'thur du 'phyang ba ni glu ma'i'o/ / spyi bor bzhag pa ni gar ma'i 'o/ /rdor bsdams bdun du brkyang ba ni bdug spos ma'i 'o/ /de nyid gyen du bskyod pa ni me tog ma'i 'o/ /de las mthe bong gnyis brkyang ste bskor ba ni mar me ma'i 'o// rdor bsdams bkrol nas byug pa'i tshul ltar byed pa ni dri chab ma'i 'o/ /rdor bsdams las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste cung zad rtse mo bkug pa ni lcags kyu ma'i 'o/ mdzub gnyis sbyar te brkyang ba ni/ / zhags pa ma'i 'o/ /mdzub mo gnyis 'dud pa ste g.yas g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub gnyis kar rtse sprad de lug brgyud ltar byas pa ni lcags sgrog ma'i 'o/ /rdor bsdams mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug nas bskyod pa ni dril bu ma'i ste rgyas btab kyi skabs su dgos pa'i dam rgya rnams so/ /de dag kun la driṣti ma ṭa zhes pa'i mig byin gyis rlabs/ dri shya zhes pas ye shes spyan drangs te bltas/ dzaḥhū ཾ baṃ ho sa dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas/ sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyab tu nyi dkyil dang gzhan rnams la zla dkyil bskyed/ sa ma ya st+waṃ a haṃ zhes pas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i nga rgyal bskyed/ sngags lan gsum gyis lha de dang de sngags kyi rang bzhin du sgrub pa yin no/ / chos rgya'i skabs su yang lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byed/ /las kyi phyag rgya la ji skad du/ gar dang glu dang rol dang zas/ /spyod lam la sogs bde ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni/ / las kyi phyag rgya dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas gar gyi tshul bya ste/ de yang gar gyi sngon 'gro lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur byas la/ de nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur kha 'og tu bstan pa la g.yas pa mtheb mdzub sbyar bas/ 'og nas mthe chung nas rim pa'i kha phye/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas g.yon du gar 'khyams byed cing*/ oṃ badzra satwa su saṃ gra ha ta

la sogs pa sngags bzhi po glur len zhing*/ /dbus dang 'og dang g.yas dang steng dang g.yon rnams su gar gyi pad bskor gsum gsum byas rang rang gi brjod pa'i tshe phyag rgya 'cha' ba'am/ badzra satwa su 'i dod du/ oṃ drug 'gyur gyi glu blangs pa'i gar pad bco lnga bya ba'am/ bsdu na oṃ gcig dang*/ sarba bid sogs mtshan rkyang ba glu blang ngo*/ /yo ga spyi pa'i lugs la/ badzra sa twa zhes pa lta bu mtshan rkyang pa la snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ/ zhes pa lta bu thog ma oṃ dang mthar sa bon gyis brgyan pa la sngags kyi tha snyad 'jog par snang la/ sbyong rgyud kyi rang lugs la tha snyad de mi dgos kyang*/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab kyi skabs 'dir don ni 'dra bar bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ni/ gtso bo dang sbyong rgyal gyi las rgya'o/ /g.yas mchog sbyin dngagayon chos gos kyi grwa 'dzin pa ni rgyal mchog rin chen gyi'o/ /chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya ni shākya thub pa'i 'o/ /g.yas snying gar skyabs sbyin dang g.yon lte bar chos gos kyi grwa 'dzin pa ni me tog cher rgyas kyi'o/ /g.yas snying gar khu tshur kha gyen la bstan pa ni spyan ma dang*/ mā ma kī'i 'o/ /g.yas khu tshur dpung pa g.yon du 'jog pa ni gos dkar mo'i 'o/ / g.yas su 'jog pa ni sgrol ma'i 'o/ /de bzhi la g.yon pa gdan la brten pa'o/ /g.yon khu tshur nang du lta ba dkur bzhag /g.yas pa'i thugs kar gan rkyal gyen du gtod pa ni rdor sems kyi 'o/ / g.yas kyi khu tshur snying ga nas mdun du sor brgyad tsam du 'cha'/ g.yon gyi khu tshur yang de'i gdong du bzhag pa ni rgyal po'i'o/ /snying gar khu tshur kha sbyor g.yon 'og tu byas pa las rna ba thug pa'i bar mda' gzhu 'gengs pa ltar byed pa ni chags pa'o/ khu tshur gnyis kha sprad snying kha'i thad du mtheb mdzub gnyis se gol gtogs pa ni legs pa'i'o/ khu tshur gnyis gshibs pa'i mdzub mo dpral bar 'jog pa ni rin chen gyi'o/

khu tshur gnyis snying gar g.yas bskor byed pa ni gzi brjid kyi'o/ / g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i gru mo btsugs te khu tshur bcings ba ni rgyal mtshan gyi'o/ khu tshur bskor te kha'i 'gram du bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'i 'o/ /snying gar g.yon khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa la g.yas khu tshur mtheb mdzub sbyar nas g.yon pa'i mthe chung nas rim gyi kha 'byed pa'i tshul ni chos kyi'o/ /g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag /g.yas khu tshur 'phyar ba ni rnon po'i 'o/ khu tshur gnyis kha sprad nas/ /'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar lus kyi phyi rol du g.yas bskor gyis bskor tshul byas pa ni rgyu'i 'o/ /glu len pa'i phyag rgya dang 'dra rung las kha'i mdun nas cung zad khu tshur gyen du gtegs pa ni smra ba'i 'o/ khu tshur bkrol ba las byung ba'i thal mo sbyar ba 'gram pa g.yas dang g.yon dang spyi bor 'jog pa ni las kyi'o/ khu tshur gnas dgur reg nas mthar dpral bar thal mo gdab pa ni srung ba'i 'o/ /de la gnas dgu ni/ snying mgrin ltag snying nu bar dang*/ /snying mgrin rgyab dang dpral ba'o/ /zhes te/ snying gsum po ni dbus dang g.yas dang g.yon/ /mgrin pa gnyis po ni de'i g.yas g.yon no/ khu tshur g.yas pa'i mthe chung nas dang*/ /g.yon pa'i mdzub mo nas bkrol ba yin/ / oṃ ṭuṃ sogs kyis phyag rgyas gnas dgu dang gcig go khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe chung mche ba ltar byas nas kha'i 'gram du bzhag pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o/ khu tshur gnyis btsir pa ni rdo rje khu tshur gyi'o/ khu tshur gnyis sgeg pa'i tshul gyis dkur bzhag la mgo g.yon du dud pa ni sgeg mo'i'o/ khu tshur gnyis mgo bo'i g.yas g.yon du 'phreng ba 'ching ba'i tshul byed pa ni 'phreng ba ma'i 'o/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul du byed pa ni glu ma'i 'o/ khu tshur gnyis kyis gar bskor ba rdo rje las dang 'dra rung ba ni gar ma'i 'o/

khu tshur gnyis cung zad kha 'thur du bstan zhing bskyod pa bdug spos ma'i 'o/ khu tshur kha gyen du bstan zhing 'thor ba ni me tog ma'i 'o/ khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe bong gshibs te bsgreng ba ni mar me ma'i 'o/ khu tshur gnyis brkyang nas dri chab byug tshul byed pa ni dri chab ma'i 'o/ /g.yas khu tshur mdzub mo lcags kyu lta bu dang*/ /g.yon khu tshur gyi mthe'u chung sgrel ba ni lcags kyu ma'i dang*/ khu tshur gnyis kyi 'khrig ma'i rgyab sbyar zhing*/ mdzub mo 'dud pa ni zhags pa ma'i dang*/ khu tshur gnyis kha gyen bstan gyi mdzub mo dang mthe chung 'dud pa ni lcags sgrog ma'i dang*/ khu tshur gnyis rgyab bsnol zhing sbyar bas btsir ba ni dril bu ma'i ste de dag ni las kyi phyag rgyas rgyas 'debs pa rnams so/ /de dag la phyag rgya'i rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dku g.yon gyi phyogs su lag pa gnyis se gol gtogs cing dkrol ba'o/ /de dag las spro zhing nus na/ lha re re bzhin sngon 'gro dang rjes de dag tshang ba re bya zhing*/ de tsam mi nus na gtso bo gcig pu la tshar gcig tshang ba dang*/ gzhan bzhi tshan bzhi tshan la tshang bar byed do/ /de yang cho ga mkhan po rnams la rab tu grags pa yin gyi/ de bas mang ba dang nyung ba la yang mi rung ba ni ma yin no/ /phyag rgya chen po ni rang rang gi snying po'am/ rang sngags lan gsum gsum bzlas te 'ching ba yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la las rgya dang 'dra ba las rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ me tog cher rgyas gnyis la g.yon mnyam bzhag go /g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sprad la gzhan rnams brkyang ba snying gar kha phyir bstan pa dang*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub 'dra rung gi snying gar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar ba dpung pa g.yon par bzung ba dang de nyid dpung pa g.yas su 'jog pa ste bzhi po de dag ni lha mo bzhi'i 'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ni g.yas kyi mthe bong mthe chung gis mnan/

mdzub gung srin gsum snying gar bsgreng g.yon khu tshur nang du bstan pa dkur brten pa'o/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i ni las rgya dang 'dra'o/ /chags pa'i ni snying gar g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi mdzub stengs su g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi mtha' bzhag nas mda' 'gengs byed pa'o/ /legs pa'i yang las rgya dang 'dra/ rin chen gyi ni g.yas khu tshur mdzod spur 'jog cing g.yon dkur brten pa'o/ /gzi brjid kyi ni g.yas snying gar khu tshur las mdzub gung mthe chung gsum cung zad grol ba'o/ /rgyal mtshan gyi ni khu tshur phrag pa g.yon par 'jog pa'o/ /bzhad pa'i ni g.yas khu tshur kha'i grwar 'jog pa'o/ /chos kyi ni g.yon khu tshur dkur bzhag /g.yas thugs kar mtheb mdzub sprad pa'o/ /rnon po'i ni g.yon khu tshur snying gar kha gyen du bstan/ g.yas khu tshur las sor mo gnyis brkyang ba 'phyar ba'i tshul lam/ yang na las rgya dnga'adra ba'o/ /rgyuu yi nikhu tshur las gung mo bsgreng zhing bskor ba'o/ / smra ba'i ni g.yas khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa kha'i mdun du 'jog pa'o/ /las kyi ni rdor sems ltar las g.yon snyems pa'i phyag rgya ste khu tshur kha gyen du bstan/ sor mo'i tshig gong ma rnams dku la reg pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i ni lag pa khu tshur lte ba'i thad du bsnol/ /de nas yar drangs te dpung pa gnyis kyi khar kha phyir bstan pa'o/

/gnod sbyin gyi ni las rgya dang 'dra'o/ khu tshur gyi ni rdor sdams mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug pa'o/ /sgeg mo'i ni rdo rje khu tshur gnyis snyems pa'i tshul lo/ /'phreng ba ma'i ni khu tshur las mtheb mdzub gnyis sbyar ba kha phyir bstan/ dpral ba'i g.yas g.yon du 'dren pa'i tshul lo/ /glu ma'i ni g.yon khu tshur bsgreng ba'i lag nya'i thad du g.yas pa'i 'dzub mos pi waṃ bskul ba'i tshul lo/ /gar ma'i ni thal mo sbug por sbyar ba bskyod cing de nas phye ste thal mo g.yas mgo dang*/ g.yon sta zur du bzhag pa'o/ /lcags kyu ma'i ni g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag cing*/ khu tshur g.yas pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyu 'dra ba'am/ rdo rje rgyal po dang 'dra ba'ang yin no/ /zhags pa ma'i ni khu tshur kha sbyor lte ba nas snying ga dang de nas mgrin pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi thad tsam du kha phyir bstan nas 'dzin pa'o/ /lcags sgrog ma'i ni/ khu tshur kha sbyor snying ga nas lte ba dang*/ de nas pus mo'i thad kar drangs te kha sbubs pa'o/ /dril bu ma'i ni g.yas khu tshur dril bu khrol ba'i tshul du byed pa'o/ /de dag ni phyag chen gyi rgyas 'debs tshul te/ g.yon gsal kha med pa rnams gdan la brten pa yin la/ snga phyir khu tshur zhes pa las gzhan gsal kha med pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur te mthe bong nang du bcug sor mo lhag ma bzhis bsdams pa'o/ /las bcol gyi skabs kyi phyag rgya ni/ 'ga' zhig dam rgya dang*/ 'ga' zhig las rgya dang*/ 'ga' zhig phyag chen du 'dod pa sogs mi 'dra ba du ma byung yang cho ga gang la phyag rgya bzhi skor gyis rgyas btab yod phyin chad phyag chen ltar byed pa 'thad de/ gzhan la khungs med cing de lta bu la khungs gsal yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dam rgya 'ba' zhig gis rgyas 'debs pa'i lugs la ni las bcol la yang dam rgya kho na las 'os med do/ /des na phyi'i sems dpa' rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya dang*/

spros pa la dga' na phyogs kyi rim pa dang mthun pa'i sems dpa' bzhi'o/ /nyan rang la thun mong du g.yas dpung pa'i thad du khu tshur dang*/ g.yon snying ga'i thad du khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'o/ /khro bo rnams la khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya'o/ /'jig rten pa rnams la gar 'khyams dang pad bskor sngon du 'gro ba'i thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba'o/ /gal te dam rgyas byed na/ lag pa g.yon de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur bkan la/ /g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis 'byed pa'i tshul byas nas/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba ni sems dpa' rnams kyi'o/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya kha phye nas mthe bong mthe chung sbyar sor mo lhag ma brkyang ba ni/ nyan thos rnams kyi'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba las mthe chung nas brtsams te sor mo gzhan rnams nang du bskum zhing sor mo bsgring ba ni/ rang rgyal gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje nang bsdams las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad/ tha ma bzhi so sor brkyang ba ni/ khro bo la sogs pa rnams kyi'o/ /thal mo la mthe bong dang mthe chung sbyar/ lhag ma rnams brkyang ba padma kha 'bus lta bu ni/ 'jig rten pa spyi'i dam rgya'o/ /des na nyan rang gi dam rgya la gzhan gang na'ang khungs rnam dag med pas 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa nas bshad pa bzhin bya dgos so/ /de dag ni chos 'di yo ga'i lugs su byed na nges par dgos pa'i phyag rgya rnams so/ /mi shes pa'i rang bzhin skye bo mang po brdzun gyis bslu bar byed pa kha cig 'di skad ces dku g.yon gyi phyogs su khu tshur steng 'og tu kha sbyor las rgya dngos yin/ ngag tu rtsa rig bzla ba'i tadya thā nas phyag rgya bkrol la g.yas g.yon snying ga gsum du pad skor byed pa de'i yan lag ste las kyi phyag rgya dang de'i rjes la mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byed pa ni dam rgya dang*/ /ngag nas kun rig gi sngags thung bzla ba ni chos rgya dang*/

mdun gyi gtso bo'i sku la rtog pa ni phyag chen te/ phyag rgya bkrol nas thal mo snying gar sbyor bzhin du las bcol gyi tshig brjod pa'i mthar dku g.yon du lag pa gnyis kas se gol gtogs pa ni/ /las la sbyor ba'o/ /zhes smra te log pa'i tshig 'di shin tu ches cher rlom pa'i mtshan nyid pa rnams nas bzung*/ mtha' 'khob kyi skye bo blun po'i bar du mgo 'khor bar gyur te/ 'di la dam rgya rang sngags med pa dang*/ chos rgya la sngags yig gi gzugs brnyan med pa dang*/ las dam chos zhes phyag rgya bzhi'i go rim 'khrugs pa dang*/ phyag chen la sku'i rnam 'gyur med pa dang*/ khyed rang 'dod pa'i las rgyas sngon 'gro rjes la byed par thal ba dang*/ de skabs phyag 'tshal gyi skabs su phyag rgya dngos su 'dod pa de bcas sngags kyi dngos gzhi'i skabs su gar byed pas/ mdun mgron la phud dang ston mo drangs/ mgron po dngos la bkru bshal sbyin pa lta bu 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ gnas skabs de nyid du phyag rgya bkrol zhes lan gnyis smra ba ni/ phyag rgya bkrol nas sangs rgyas gshegs zhes bya ba'i lung khas len mkhan yin pa'i phyir/ phyag rgyas btab ma thag tu gshegs gsol byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ khu tshur kha spras dang pad skor gsum po gang su ci'i yang las rgya ma yin pa'i phyir/ khu tshur kha phye ba la phyag rgya bkrol ba'i tha snyad mi 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ rtsa rig kyang las rgya'i sngags ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sngags thung bzlos pa tsam la chos kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid tshang ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ mdun gyi lha sku la rtog cing yid la byed pa tsam phyag chen ma yin zhing*/ yin na dam rgya yang phyag chen du thal ba dang*/ gal te 'di phyag rgya bzhi rgyas btab yin na rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs ni/ spyir bdag mdun bum bskyed sogs gnas skabs su du mar 'byung yang don gyi gtso bo bdag bskyed kyi skabs su dgos pa las/

khyed der mi byed pa'i dgos don gyi gtso bo gtor ba'i phyir dang*/ /rje btsun chen po'i rjes su 'brang ba yin na ni mal gyo sogs gong ma rnams kun rig la dam rgya bcas nas las bcol byed kyi/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs mi dgos par bzhed pa'i lugs gcig dang*/ rang bzhed la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs rgyud 'dir tshig zur gyis thon pas bzhi po so sor byed na legs so zhes so sor phye nas lugs gnyis su mdzad kyi/ snga ma rnams dam rgya bcas nas las bcol tsam byed pa la/ kho bos bltas na phyag rgya bzhi tshang 'dug kyang snga ma rnams kyis phyag rgya bzhi tshang ba ma shes shing mi dgos par 'dod do/ /zhes nam du yang ma gsungs pa la/ khyed dam rgya bcas nas las bcol byed pa la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab tshang bar 'dod kyin 'dug pa'i phyir/ rje btsun chen po dang 'gal ba sogs mdor na 'khrul ba'i phung po chen po 'di blo gros shin tu chung ngu de'i nang du chud pa shin tu ngo mtshar che'o/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /de yan chad kyis phyag rgyas gtso bo rnams bshad zin to/ /mchod pa nyer lnga'i skabs kyi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur gnyis mgo bo'i steng du 'jog pa cod pan dang*/ mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i zlum po rna ba la reg pa/ rna rgyan dang*/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas mgul gyi dbus nas g.yas g.yon du drwa phyed 'bri ba mgul rgyan dang*/ g.yas g.yon res mos kyis phrag pa nas rked pa'i bar dang*/ phrag pa cig shos kyi bar la 'bri ba ni/ se mo do dang*/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi bar lhu g.yon g.yas la byabs pa dpung rgyan dang*/ de bzhin du 'khrig ma g.yas g.yon dang*/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon la lag gdub dang*/ rkang gdub/ de rnams ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya kho nas reg pas so/ /g.yas pa'i gung mo'i dkyil nas g.yon pa'i mdzub mos 'khyud pa sor gdub dang*/ g.yon bde gshegs khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i mthil bzhag pa ni gdugs dang*/

khu tshur nyis brtseg phrag pa gang rung gi phyogs su bzhag pa ni rgyal mtshan dang*/ khu tshur gyi gung mdzub gnyis nam mkha' la steng 'og tu bskor ba ni ba dan dang*/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas pa'i gung mdzub gnyis kyis mtho dman du lda ldi 'gel ba'i tshul ni lda ldi dang*/ lag pa gcig gi yu ba 'dzin tshul dang*/ cig shos thal mo rnga yab kyi tshul du byed pa ni rnga yab kyi dang*/ lag pa g.yon mnyam bzhag /g.yas smin mtshams nas 'thur du bstan pa ni bla bre'o/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs pa ni seng ge'i khri dang*/ khu tshur gnyis g.yas g.yon du drangs pa ni gzims cha dang*/ khu tshur g.yon snyingagar bzhag /g.yas pa'i gung mdzub rtse sprad pa zlum po ni khang bzang zlum po dang*/ de nyid gru bzhir byed pa khang bzang gru bzhi dang*/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis khang brtsegs dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen bstan gnyis kyis zla gdan dang*/ me tog dang pi waṃ gong dang 'dra/ ting ting zhig brdung tshul gyis de nyid dang*/ g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas khu tshur gyi dri'i phye ma 'byed pa'i tshul gyi dri bzang dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gyen du kha phye bas lha bshos dang*/ khu tshur gnyis kyi rgyab nas nam bza' g.yogs te mdun du bsnon pa'i tshul nam bza' ste/ de dag kyang phyag rgya'i rnams grangs tsam mo/ /bstod ring gi skabs spyir rdo rje dril thabs tsam gyis chog la/ nyang stod pho rog pa'i lag len deng sang phal cher byed pa ni/ thog ma dril gsil byas nas/ dril bu snying ga'i thad kyi g.yon phyaugs cung zad dma' sar bzung la 'di ltar bya ste/ tshigs rkang dang po rdo rje sen skor bya/ gnyis pa rdor dril dang bcas pad skor te/ gsum pa rang rang so so'i phyag len bcings/ /bzhi pa pad skor sngon 'gro thal mo sbyor zhes so/ /tshigs bcad bzhi po la mtshon na/ chos dbyings sogs dang*/ rdo rje gsor te dril bu'i thog gang tsam nas g.yas g.yon gang rung du bskor/

rnam par sogs la pad skor bya/ ting nge 'dzin sogs la mnyam bzhag /phyag 'tshal sogs la snying gar pad skor mgyogs par byas la/ kun rig ces pa'i skabs thal mo sbyar/ la'o zhes pa'i skabs dril gsil tsam/ de dag gi bar bar du chab rtsed dang sgor rtsed byed do/ /de dag skye bo mgo bskor gyi phyag rgya yin kyang byed ni byed kyin gda'o/ /de ltar na phyag rgya rags rim tsam bshad zin no/ /gsum pa rjes kyi skabs su cho ga las gsal ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog dang*/ gshegs gsol dang rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa sogs spyi dang 'dra la/ kha cig sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzung nas badzra satwa hūṃ lan gsum gyis phyag rgya dkrol/ zhes zer ba ni rgyud gzhung gang na'ang med pa'i legs bshad du gda'o/ /spyi bor bzung zhes pa'i brda chad kyang shin tu rmongs tshig yin zhing*/ sngar rgyas btab pa'i phyag rgya gcig kyang 'grol rgyu med pa la/ rgyas btab kyi skabs ye med pa'i phyag rgya 'grol ba 'di dang*/ rgyas btab kyi lha dang phyag rgya shin tu mang po dag sngags dang phyag rgya gcig kho nas 'grol ba 'di dang*/ sngar phyag rgya bzhis rgyas ma btab pa la 'grol dgos pa 'di dang*/ rgyud 'di nas ye ma bshad pa'i lha dang sngags kyi phyag rgya gcig gis rgyud 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha mtha' dag gi phyag rgya 'grol bar byed pa ste/ bzhad gad las kyang ches bzhad gad kyi gnas rnam pa bzhi'o/ /da ni 'di dpyad de/ rgyud 'di'i sems dpa' bcu drug gi sngags la badzra rā dza dzaḥ la sogs pa byed de/ rdor dbyings la sogs pa gzhan nas 'byung ba dang*/ lha'i ngo bo dang sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs 'dra ba'i phyir ro snyam pa de phal cher la snang zhing*/ yang snga phyir byon pa 'ga' zhig gi kho bos dkyus su bshad pa dang mthun pa'ang mdzad pa la/ rdor dbyings kyi 'dres gcig kyang mi rung bar 'dod pa kha cig de mi rigs te 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs su de ltar bshad pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i sngags kyi mthar sems dpa' bcu drug gi sa bon spel nas rol mo brdung ba la sogs pa byed pa'i sngags tsam yin gyi/

bzlas bya'i sngags yin pa'i gsal kha med pas bskyed bzlas kyi sngags ni gzhan nas blangs pa bzang bar 'dod do// de ni ma yin te brdung ba'i sngags ni sham pa ta la sogs pa dag yin gyi/ sngags gong ma rnams brdung sngags yin par ston pa'i tshig kyang med la/ de'i phyir bzlas sngags yin par the tshom med la/ yang rgyud 'di'i stod smad gang nas kyang sems dpa' bcu drug gi sngags gsungs pa gzhan ni ye nas med/ gcig pu 'di kho na yin na rol gar gyi skabs su bshad pa yin du chug kyang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs su ci'i phyir blangs du mi rung*/ rang gzhung nas lar ma bshad pa de dag len pa bas/ gsal bar bshad pa 'di ci'i phyir mi len/ gnas skabs gang du byung kyang bla ste/ rtsis btab kyis dgos pa chung yang gzhan dag gis rdor dbyings sogs dang cho ga bsres pa la dgra ltar lta bzhin du rang nyid rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i sngags bor nas/ rgyud gzhan gyi sngags dang bsres pa ni shin tu mi mkhas pa'i rnam thar yin zhing*/ cho ga las kyang sngags yid ches gtso bo yin pas sngags ma 'khrul ba dgos pa go bar gyis shig /de ltar na thams cad rig pa'i cho ga'i ngag 'don 'khor ba kun grol gyi zur 'debs 'di yang tā ra nā thas zhor byung du smras pa'o// // dge'o/ / bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/thams cad rig pa'i cho ga 'khor ba kun grol gyi zur 'debs bzhugs so/ -PAGE 294--PAGE 295--PAGE 275-
